text:
Lina: Heads-up: since the affinity policy rollout at 02:10 we have ~18 pods stuck Pending on GPU nodes in us-west-2.
Omar: saw the same, nodes show GPUs free but scheduler reports unschedulable.
Priya: alert from sre-bot: `FailedScheduling: node(s) didn't match Pod's nodeAffinity/taints` for batch-infer job
sre-bot: [ALERT] 18 Pending GPU pods in cluster gpu-pool-west-2 (avg wait 3m)
Ben: output from `kubectl describe pod gpu-batch-123 -n infra` shows: 
```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----     ------            ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2m    default-scheduler  0/12 nodes are available: 12 node(s) had taint {dedicated=gpu}: NoToleration.
```
Lina: that's the new `dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule` taint we added. Some infra daemonsets didn't add tolerations.
Omar: which daemonsets? I suspect the KV-cache sidecars for smaller inference pools.
Priya: also seeing odd fragmentation: we have nodes with 1 GPU free but pods request 2 GPUs — binpacking mismatch after quota change.
Ben: cost note: wasted GPU-hours piling up while preemption churn continues, FYI finance ping incoming.
Jia: quick mitigation: add toleration to the daemonsets and bump `topologySpreadConstraints` to avoid strict AZ packing.
Lina: patch ready, testing locally. Plan: 1) add toleration to ds/gpu-metrics 2) relax PodAntiAffinity on batch-infer 3) roll descheduler job tomorrow.
Omar: can we also temporary allow `PreferNoSchedule` instead of hard taint? avoids mass evictions.
Priya: +1, also we should avoid changing scheduler predicates mid-day — live traffic.
deploy-bot: deploy started for lint/patch-ttl (Lina) -> rollout 3/3 succeeded
Lina: deployed to canary (gpu-pool-west-2-a). Can folks verify pending pods move?
Ben: one moved, 5 still Pending, looks like node-level GPU fragmentation persists.
Omar: idea: add a small admission controller that packs fractional-gpu requests on same node — but that's mid-term.
Jia: short-term: consider increasing allowed `maxPodsPerNode` in scheduler config for GPU node types.
Priya: filing a runbook update: add tolerations for infra agents + step to run `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` on affected nodes
Lina: I'll run a targeted deschedule in 10m and report back. If anything else, ping me @lina
Omar: thanks, keeping an eye. :eyes:
